newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Wharf 10 yr bond "A".
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Wharf 10 yr bond "A".

text.p: Ratings agency Standard and Poors Corp said on Friday it had assigned its A long term rating to Wharf International Finance Ltd's US$350 million 144A ten year bond issue and had placed a negative rating outlook on the bonds.

"The rating reflects Wharf's stable income base from its property investment and container terminal businesses, and to a lesser extent from its hotel operations, offset by some exposure to property development activity and the still loss-making cable TV venture, Wharf Cable," S&P said.
Wharf Cable had operating losses of HK$645 million in 1995.
"The rating outlook is negative, reflecting the uncertainty surround the success of Wharf Cable and the impact of negative cash flow on Wharf," S&P said.
